```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 90.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 200.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 151.4      # s the probe actually used

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Evaluate box-wing configuration against calibrated baseline
hb_ratio = 0.15
res = box_wing_reconfiguration(airplane, hb_ratio=hb_ratio)
ac_bx = res["box_airplane"]

m_root_base = float(res["m_root_base_kNm"])
m_root_fwd = float(res["m_root_fwd_kNm"])
m_root_aft = float(res["m_root_aft_kNm"])
m_root_max = float(res["m_root_max_kNm"])
bending_relief_pct = float(res["bending_relief_pct"])

e_base = float(res["e_base"])
e_box = float(res["e_box"])
cdi_reduction_pct = float(res["induced_drag_reduction_pct"])

ld_base = float(res["ld_base_max"])
ld_box = float(res["ld_box_max"])
delta_ld = float(res["delta_ld"])
v_best = float(res["v_box_max"])
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"-{bending_relief_pct:.1f}%"`]{.hero-value}
[reduction in maximum limit root bending moment per spar relative to cantilever baseline]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** Replacing the [calibrated baseline](2026-09-30-01-what-does-a-discus-2c-geometry-reconstructed-from-published-data-look.qmd) cantilever wing with a joined-wingtip box wing splits the [`{python} f"{airplane.s_ref:.2f} m²"`]{.key} area equally across vertically separated wings joined at the tips (@fig-box-wing). Under [limit manoeuvre loads](2026-09-30-03-are-wing-structural-loads-reasonable-under-a-jar-22-5-3g-limit-manoeuv.qmd), splitting total lift relieves single-spar root bending moment by [`{python} f"{bending_relief_pct:.1f}%"`]{.key}, falling from [`{python} f"{m_root_base:.1f} kN·m"`]{.key} to [`{python} f"{m_root_max:.1f} kN·m"`]{.key}. Aerodynamically, mutual induced-velocity coupling reduces induced drag by [`{python} f"{cdi_reduction_pct:.1f}%"`]{.key}, raising span efficiency from [`{python} f"{e_base:.2f}"`]{.key} to [`{python} f"{e_box:.2f}"`]{.key}. Despite lower Reynolds number profile drag from halved chords, best glide ratio improves by [`{python} f"{delta_ld:+.2f}"`]{.key} to [`{python} f"{ld_box:.2f}"`]{.key} at [`{python} f"{v_best:.0f} km/h"`]{.key}.

::: {.callout-tip}
## New user specifications
Asked of the user, 2026-09-30:

1. **box-wing height-to-span ratio: `{python} f"{hb_ratio:.2f}"`**, user brief.
2. **box-wing area split: equal**, user brief.
:::

```{python}
#| label: fig-box-wing
#| fig-cap: "Planform geometry layout and glide ratio polar comparison between baseline and box-wing configuration."
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4.2))

# Subplot 1: Top-down planform comparison
w_base = airplane.wings[0]
y_b = np.array([xs.xyz_le[1] for xs in w_base.xsecs])
x_le_b = np.array([xs.xyz_le[0] for xs in w_base.xsecs])
x_te_b = x_le_b + np.array([xs.chord for xs in w_base.xsecs])

w_fwd = ac_bx.wings[0]
w_aft = ac_bx.wings[1]
y_f = np.array([xs.xyz_le[1] for xs in w_fwd.xsecs])
x_le_f = np.array([xs.xyz_le[0] for xs in w_fwd.xsecs])
x_te_f = x_le_f + np.array([xs.chord for xs in w_fwd.xsecs])

y_a = np.array([xs.xyz_le[1] for xs in w_aft.xsecs])
x_le_a = np.array([xs.xyz_le[0] for xs in w_aft.xsecs])
x_te_a = x_le_a + np.array([xs.chord for xs in w_aft.xsecs])

for sgn in [1, -1]:
    ax1.fill(np.concatenate([sgn * y_b, sgn * y_b[::-1]]),
             np.concatenate([x_le_b, x_te_b[::-1]]),
             color='blue', alpha=0.15, label='Baseline wing' if sgn == 1 else "")
    ax1.plot(sgn * y_b, x_le_b, 'b-', lw=1.2)
    ax1.plot(sgn * y_b, x_te_b, 'b--', lw=1.2)

    ax1.fill(np.concatenate([sgn * y_f, sgn * y_f[::-1]]),
             np.concatenate([x_le_f, x_te_f[::-1]]),
             color='red', alpha=0.35, label='Box fwd wing' if sgn == 1 else "")
    ax1.plot(sgn * y_f, x_le_f, 'r-', lw=1.5)
    ax1.plot(sgn * y_f, x_te_f, 'r-', lw=1.5)

    ax1.fill(np.concatenate([sgn * y_a, sgn * y_a[::-1]]),
             np.concatenate([x_le_a, x_te_a[::-1]]),
             color='purple', alpha=0.35, label='Box aft wing' if sgn == 1 else "")
    ax1.plot(sgn * y_a, x_le_a, 'm-', lw=1.5)
    ax1.plot(sgn * y_a, x_te_a, 'm-', lw=1.5)

    ax1.plot([sgn * y_f[-1], sgn * y_a[-1]], [x_te_f[-1], x_le_a[-1]], 'k-', lw=2.0,
             label='Tip endplate' if sgn == 1 else "")

ax1.set_xlabel('Spanwise station y (m)')
ax1.set_ylabel('Fuselage station x (m)')
ax1.invert_yaxis()
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax1.legend(loc='lower right', fontsize=8)

# Subplot 2: Glide polar comparison
ax2.plot(res['speeds_kmh'], res['ld_base_arr'], 'b-o', lw=1.8, label=f"Baseline (best {ld_base:.1f})")
ax2.plot(res['speeds_kmh'], res['ld_box_arr'], 'r-s', lw=1.8, label=f"Box-wing (best {ld_box:.1f})")
ax2.set_xlabel('Airspeed (km/h)')
ax2.set_ylabel('Glide Ratio L/D')
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax2.legend(loc='upper right')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
